steps.title: Resuspend magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Shake the Agencourt AMPure XP bottle until the magnetic particles are fully resuspended.

steps.title: Add AMPure XP solution
steps.instruction: Add to each sample a volume equal to 1.8 × the sample volume (or, if desired, as low as 0.8 × the sample volume) of Agencourt AMPure XP solution. Pipette‑mix the mixture ten times, or vortex for a few seconds.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bind beads with magnet
steps.instruction: Place the reaction plate or tube onto an Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate and allow beads to separate for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from the plate or tube and discard it.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL 70 % ethanol, incubate at room temperature for ≥30 seconds, then aspirate and discard (first wash).
Repeat the same steps for a second wash.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave the plate at room temperature until the beads are dry, approximately 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL elution buffer (10 mM Tris, no TE) to the dried beads (volume may be reduced to as low as 20 µL, though recovery is harder). Pipette‑mix ten times or vortex for a few seconds.

steps.title: Elution incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Separate eluate
steps.instruction: Place the plate onto the Agencourt SPRIPlate Super Magnet Plate for 1 minute to separate beads from the eluate.

steps.title: Collect purified product
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared eluate to a fresh plate or PCR tube (preferably not a 1.5 mL tube to allow multichannel pipetting).
